svg.aria-label: hw-pass: a hardware password typer. The device types a password over USB, locks with a PIN, works over Bluetooth LE, keeps the computer awake, and runs on three M5Stack boards.

text.font-family: "Segoe UI", Ubuntu, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
